readingLead: Choose a related article to keep exploring.
title: Continuation clicks
help: First-party clicks on related articles and topic links. These are not impressions, completed reads, search CTR or revenue.
unavailable: Continuation data is unavailable. The other analytics remain available.
empty: No continuation clicks were recorded in this window. Tracking may be disabled or opted out; this is not proof that nobody continued reading.
rawOnly: A 12-month continuation report is unavailable. Choose a range of 90 days or less; these link dimensions are not kept in the long-term rollup.
clipped: The requested range exceeds raw-data retention; only the available window is shown.
